status: predeclared before benchmark compilation or execution
correctness_gate: core, flags and lifetime stages must each pass direct complete ordered equality against separately compiled exact V11 before any benchmark; do not repeat the combined all route without a new state-coverage reason
fixtures: LED_1 through LED_8, case1, then all sixteen metadata-filtered tiny development frames in fixed index order
excluded_from_benchmark: two-class synthetic bank, synthetic zero maxima, larger image and mask/lifetime routes remain correctness cases only; no heldout RGB decode/view/match

banks.LED: all 900 SMD poses; 5 scales by 180 angles

order: For image i and call round r, rotate case order by (i+r) modulo 3, reverse it when (i+r) is odd; cold uses r=0, warm uses r=1,2, measured uses r=3 through17. Reset the three independent workspaces once before each image, retain each across cold/warm/measured phases
oracle: cold exact V11 result captured before conversion/CSV work, then every cold/warm/measured output directly compared in full ordered form outside all internal matcher timing and wall timing; baseline is checked on every round too
timing: existing internal MatchTimings phase/total values plus adapter-inclusive steady-clock wall around each full call; conversion to ordered records, equality and CSV writes outside all timers; no new counters/instrumentation
wall_limitation: Exact V11 adapter copies matcher output to its independent Result type inside wall timing; internal API/search timings are the primary baseline comparisons. Candidate off/on wall paths are symmetric.
runtime_provenance: Pin compiler, OpenCV world, libgomp, libstdc++ and libgcc DLL bytes in build/run source hashes; record OS version, processor identifier/architecture and logical processor count. This does not pin every Windows system DLL or remove thermal/scheduler variance.
summaries: Keep all samples. For each image compute median of 15 paired on/off search, internal-total and wall ratios, and off/V11 ratios. Summarize equal-weight images with median and geometric mean; retain every regression and no-gain image. Descriptive p10/p50/p90 only, no confidence interval claim.
claims: Exact output reuse can improve speed only; this experiment makes no accuracy-improvement claim, no production adoption and no deployment claim. Capacity remains sixteen independent of benchmark outcome.
